Name: Craftable Butterfly Hutches
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds a recipe to the craftable list that lets you craft a smaller version of the butterfly hutch and place it anywhere craftables can be placed.

Butterflies appear after you leave a location and come back (attracting them takes time!)

The hutches are customizable by editing the config.json file:

"[b]SpriteSheetOffsetRows[/b]": 0, - Number of rows to shift the new sprite down on [b]TileSheets/Craftables[/b]. Use this only if you have other mods adding craftables to offset the place where this mod puts its sprite.
"[b]HutchCost[/b]": "338 40 709 40 425 4", - This is the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Object_data#Raw_data]material[/url] cost of crafting the hutch (default is 40 refined quartz (338), 40 hardwood (709), and 4 fairy rose seeds (425))
"[b]SkillReq[/b]": "Farming 6", - Skill type and skill level required to gain the hutch recipe
"[b]MinButterfliesDensity[/b]": 0.01, - minimum butterfy density (1.0 is one butterfly per map tile)
"[b]MaxButterfliesDensity[/b]": 0.05  - maximum butterfy density (1.0 is one butterfly per map tile)


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
